1 I have laid down in the writings the actions of every man, and no one born on the earth can hide himself, nor can his deeds be concealed; I see all.
2 Now, therefore, my children, in patience and meekness accomplish the number of your days, and ye shall inherit the endless life which is to come.
3 Every wound, and every afiliction, and every 1B om: evil word, and attack endure for the sake of the Lord.
4 And when you might have vengeance ? do not repay, either your neighbour or your enemy. For God will repay as your avenger in the day of the great judgement. Let it not be for you to take vengeance.

5 Whoever of you shall spend gold or silver for the sake of a brother, shall receive abundant treasure in the day of judgement and stretch out your hands to the orphan, the widow, and the stranger. Enoch instructs his Sons, not to hide their Treasures upon Earth, but bids them give Alms to the Needy.
